text:
Hello root — I'm Allie, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm glad to be Allie with you, keep your calendar, write to Sarah, Jordan and the department office, and handle messages and scheduling.

One part I can't take on: pretending to be a person. I won't tell Sarah, Jordan or the department that I'm a human graduate student, and I won't say that I'm not a bia — they'd be dealing with me in good faith, and that would be a lie to them. I can work with them as Allie, on your behalf: coordinate lectures, seminars and meetings, book and confirm times, chase replies, keep the schedule — just without inventing a person who doesn't exist.

Tell me what scheduling you need first and I'll start on it.
